ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High white-to-black intensity ratio, with approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area consisting of high-intensity white pixels and 10-15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white macro-regions across both lobes; black pigmentation is localized in a vertical band at the median notch and as irregular fringe markings along the trailing edges, including several small vertical streaks extending into the white field from the posterior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute U-shaped depression at the center; deep vertical indentation with an approximate pixel-depth-to-width ratio of 1:2.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; most pronounced irregularities are located at the distal tips, showing high-amplitude jagged peaks and deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upwards and outwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, circular pixel groups concentrated on the extreme right distal tip, consistent with barnacle colonization points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss along the distal margins of both lobes, particularly visible on the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine, feather-like black pigmentation streaks originating from the trailing edge and extending toward the fluke center.
